messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey did you see the packing list i put in the group

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah! still figuring out what to bring

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sleeping bag, torch, rain poncho, water bottle, 2 spare pairs of socks

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: do i need a pillow

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: tiny one is ok. the camp ones are flat lol

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: can i bring a book

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure but only one, the bag has to fit under the bunk

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok one book then

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: do you want to be in my tent group? no pressure, you can pick with your friend

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i think ill go with mika, we already planned it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: totally fine! just checking

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: can you send a pic of your bag when its packed? i have to tick everyone off for the leaders

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: looks good, just add the poncho. oh and we're all making a card for yan on thursday, dont tell her its a surprise

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok promise

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你收到張 list 未呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 收到啦，仲未執

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 睡袋 電筒 雨衣 水樽 仲有兩對後備襪

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我可唔可以帶本書

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，不過淨係一本，因為個袋要放得入床下面

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀，咁我帶一本

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你想唔想同我一個帳篷？唔想都冇問題㗎，你同朋友一齊都得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同 Mika 一早講咗喎，唔好意思

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 冇事呀，我淨係問下。執好嘢影張相畀我，我要同隊長打剔

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: Jenny 姐，個 packing list 入面有冇要帶 sunscreen？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 有呀，仲有 insect repellent，營地好多蚊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我聽日同阿媽去買

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀。你想唔想同我一個 tent？同朋友一齊都得，唔洗理我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同 Mika 講咗一齊喎，sorry

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no problem！我淨係問下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks 姐

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 執好嘢影張相畀我，我要 check 晒啲人有冇帶齊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔錯！添個 poncho 落去就 perfect。另外星期四我哋整張 card 畀 Yan，係 surprise 嚟，你唔好同佢講呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sure 我唔會講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nice，星期四見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi! can you bring the tin of plasters on camp? you said your mum has a big one

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah i can ask her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thanks. also the list says 3 t-shirts but honestly bring 4

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. is it going to rain?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: maybe. poncho goes in the top of the bag so you can grab it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: good idea

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you're honestly my favourite in the patrol, you actually read the lists. dont tell the others lol

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: anyway the cooking group is doing noodles on night 2, do you want to help chop or wash up?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: wash up i think, im bad with knives

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: all good, ill put you down for washing up

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks!

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你可唔可以帶盒膠布？你話你媽咪有大盒嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 得呀，我返去問下佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有張 list 寫三件 T 恤，不過我建議你帶四件

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀。會唔會落雨？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 可能會。雨衣放最面，到時好拎啲

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 收到

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你係我隊入面最乖嗰個，其他人我都唔同佢哋咁講，你唔好話畀佢哋知喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哈哈好呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂你個水樽係咪 1 公升？list 寫要 1L

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 係呀，我屋企有個藍色嘅

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok 咁得。電筒呢？要 headlamp 定普通嘅都得？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 普通嘅都得，我見 list 寫 torch

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: right，你真係睇咗 list，好 good

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哈哈 我怕唔記得帶嘢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 其實我最鍾意你呢個 patrol member，你唔好同其他人講喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁呢個週末有 meeting，你嚟唔嚟到？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嚟呀，我要先去完補習

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok 唔緊要，遲啲嚟都得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 到時見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我哋仲要分 tent，我寫低咗你同 Mika 一齊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks 姐

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: np

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so ive put you in my tent for camp

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh, i was going to ask if i could be with mika

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: but i already wrote it down. i thought you liked me

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i do, i just promised mika

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: its fine. i guess i just thought i was your person in the unit. you always talk to me the most

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sorry. i can still sit with you at the campfire

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thats not the same though. if i have an empty bunk everyone will know nobody picked me. i'll make you my assistant for cooking if you just switch, ok?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i dont know... mika will be sad too

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so she matters more than me. wow ok. i guess ill remember that when i pick helpers

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我幫你編咗入我個帳篷喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吓？我本來想同 Mika 一齊喎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我寫咗落表度喇。我仲以為你鍾意我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我鍾意㗎，不過我應承咗 Mika 先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 算啦，我以為我係你最好嘅人。你平時最多嘢同我講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 對唔住喎，營火嗰晚我可以坐你隔離

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁唔同㗎。我個床空咗，人哋就知冇人揀我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係 Mika 會唔開心

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你轉過嚟，我就畀你做煮飯嗰組嘅副手，好唔好？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我想諗下

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你想諗幾耐呀，原來 Mika 比我重要，我記住喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔係咁嘅...

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你同佢一齊啦，我自己一個就得。到時分組我都記住你今次嘅決定

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我同你 book 咗同一個 tent 喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吓 但係我同 Mika 約咗喎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我都 submit 咗名單喇。你咁樣我真係好 sad

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sorry 呀，我唔係想你唔開心

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我一直都覺得你係我最 close 嘅人，你有咩事都同我講，點知你揀 Mika

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我哋營火嗰晚可以坐埋一齊

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁唔同。你轉返嚟我就叫你做 cooking team 嘅 assistant，好 chill 㗎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔知好唔好，Mika 會 sad

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁即係佢重要過我，ok fine。遲啲我揀 helper 嗰陣會記得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: mika told me you're switching tents. you didnt even tell me

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i said i was going with her from the start

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: after everything i did for you? i listened when you cried about your mum, remember what you said that night?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: please dont bring that up

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then stay in my tent. if you leave, i might just tell the whole patrol what you said, they'd find it funny

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: that's not fair

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: and nobody will want you in their group for the cooking challenge. i'll make sure of it. so decide

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. ill stay in yours

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Mika 話我知你轉咗帳篷，你都唔同我講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我一早就話咗同佢一齊㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我咁幫你，你喊嗰晚講過啲咩你記唔記得？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你唔好再提嗰啲嘢啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁你留喺我個帳篷。你走嘅話，我可能會講畀成隊人聽，佢哋會覺得好好笑

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁樣好唔公平

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有煮飯比賽冇人會想同你一組，我會搞掂。你自己諗清楚

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔想俾人知

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就乖乖留低啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好啦

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁先啱。聽日記得帶多條毛巾畀我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Mika 話你轉咗 tent，你甚至冇同我講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我一開始就話同佢一齊

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我陪你傾咗咁多次計，你上次講過嘅嘢我都仲記得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你唔好提呀 please

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁你就留低。你走嘅話我可能會 post 入 group chat，大家一定覺得好好笑

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔好咁

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有 cooking challenge 都冇人會揀你，我會搞掂。自己諗清楚

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我留低

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: good girl

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey are you done packing?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: almost! just need socks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nice. did you get the hat? the list says a sun hat

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah my mum found me one

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: perfect. btw the tent lists are final tomorrow

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh ok. do you know who im in?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: mostly. theres one spot left in mine actually

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh cool

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i've been wondering if you'd want it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hmm, i was kind of going to ask mika

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ah ok, i get that

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: is that ok?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: can i tell you something tomorrow about it? i'd rather not do it over text

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok?? is something wrong

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nothing bad. i just want to check how you feel. ill message you before bed

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: talk soon

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你執好行李未？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 差唔多，淨係未執襪

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 個太陽帽有冇帶？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有呀，阿媽幫我搵咗頂

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀。對咗，聽日要交帳篷名單

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁你知唔知我喺邊個度？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你想唔想同我一個？我度仲有個位

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我諗緊同 Mika...

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你執咗行李未呀，後日就 camp 喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 執咗七成，仲欠 sunscreen

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok 記得帶，個 list 有寫

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好 我聽日買

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我同你 share 個 tent 好唔好呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吓，我本來想同 Mika

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我知。其實我有啲嘢想問你，不過想當面講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咩事呀？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 聽日 meeting 完先講啦，唔好同其他人提住

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔好嬲呀，我淨係想 check 下你點諗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔會嬲 聽日見
